messages:
incident-bot: [pager] High error rate: smtp-gateway returning 5xx for outbound notifications. Trigger: alert-smtp-5xx-rate > 5% for 5m. Paginator: alex chen oncall.

alex chen: paging in. seen ~30% failure on prod-smtp-1, rolling spikes since 14:21 UTC. grabbing logs.

samir patel: oncall handover — i'm on laptop, can take if alex is tied. quick check: are customer retries failing or are we dropping?

alex chen: retries queuing, but upstream responds 5xx quickly. sample log:
```
2026-03-15T14:22:01Z prod-smtp-1 error: smtp send failed: 521 5.2.0 Mailbox unavailable
2026-03-15T14:22:03Z prod-smtp-1 error: tls handshake failed: x509: certificate expired
```

priya rao: rough customer impact? We need a statuspage draft ASAP. Which product flows are affected?

alex chen: notif emails for workspace invites, billing receipts, and webhook-delivery notifications hit the gateway. Estimated ~8% of outgoing notifications failing. no data plane degradation otherwise.

maria gonzalez: flagged a few enterprise customers via direct monitoring. prepping customer-facing note.

priya rao: draft initial status page update (please review):
"We are investigating a partial degradation of outbound email delivery caused by errors from our SMTP gateway. Some customers may experience failed or delayed notification emails (invitations, billing receipts). Our on-call team is actively investigating and implementing mitigations. We will post updates every 15 minutes."

nate kim: suggest adding mitigation steps we're trying: failover to secondary gateway + pause non-urgent batched sends. proposed short update to ops channel when issued.

alex chen: rolling failover to smtp-backup-2 now. command:
```bash
# switch routing for non-critical senders
/infra route update --service=smtp-gateway --target=smtp-backup-2 --selector=non-critical --dry-run=false
```

ops-runbook-bot: runbook step 3 executed: toggled routing for selector=non-critical. monitoring queue drains.

priya rao: review request: @samir @maria can you quick-check wording? keep it non-alarming and specific about affected features.

samir patel: wording looks fine. minor tweak: change "failed" to "may be delayed or not delivered" and add ETA for next update.

priya rao: updated draft: "We are investigating a partial degradation of outbound email delivery from our SMTP gateway. Customers may see delayed or undelivered notification emails (invitations, billing receipts, webhook notifications). Our on-call team is working on a failover and mitigation; next update in 15 minutes."

maria gonzalez: +1. I'll reach out to top-20 customers with custom note once we have confirmation of failover progress.

alex chen: failover reduced 5xx rate from ~30% to ~7% in 5m. still seeing TLS-related cert errors on prod-smtp-2 for some IPs. investigating cert chain.

priya rao: publishing initial status page update now. draft to publish: {"impact": "Partial degradation", "components": ["Outbound Email Delivery"], "body": "We are investigating a partial degradation... next update in 15 minutes."} 

ops-runbook-bot: /statuspage publish --incident=INC-1767890123 --update="We are investigating a partial degradation of outbound email delivery from our SMTP gateway. Some customers may experience delays or undelivered notification emails (invitations, billing receipts). Our on-call team is actively investigating. Next update in 15 minutes."

ops-runbook-bot: Published to status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-1767890123 :white_check_mark:

samir patel: posting note to #customer-ops and drafting 1:1 customer outreach for impacted enterprise tenants.

alex chen: mitigation attempt: reissue cert to prod-smtp-2 and restart service. command:
```bash
ssh admin@prod-smtp-2 'sudo systemctl restart smtp && tail -n 50 /var/log/smtp/handshake.log'
```

incident-bot: Alert suppressed — 5xx rate decreased below 10% for 10m.

alex chen: cert rotate completed; handshake logs show OK. 5xx now ~1.2% across fleet.

priya rao: proposed follow-up status update: "Mitigation in progress: we have routed non-critical traffic to a backup gateway and rotated the affected certificate. Error rate has decreased significantly and continues to improve. We will monitor and update when fully resolved."

maria gonzalez: approve to publish once we confirm steady state for 10 minutes. I'll coordinate customer messages.

nate kim: monitoring for 10m. setting a watch on retries and queue length.

ops-runbook-bot: /statuspage publish --incident=INC-1767890123 --update="Mitigation in progress: we routed non-critical traffic to a backup gateway and rotated an affected certificate. Error rate has decreased significantly and continues to improve. We will update when all services are healthy."

ops-runbook-bot: Published follow-up update.

(10 minutes later)

incident-bot: 5xx alert cleared. error rate < 0.5% for 15m.

alex chen: confirmed stable for 20m. queues drained, no new customer complaints.

priya rao: final resolved draft: "Resolved: The SMTP gateway issue has been resolved. We rotated the affected certificate and routed traffic to backups during mitigation. Email delivery service is operating normally; customers may see delayed retries complete. If you continue to see issues, please contact support."

maria gonzalez: +1 to publish resolved. sending enterprise notifications now.

ops-runbook-bot: /statuspage publish --incident=INC-1767890123 --update="Resolved: The SMTP gateway incident has been resolved. We rotated the affected certificate and routed traffic to backups during mitigation. Email delivery is operating normally; delayed notifications should complete. If you continue to have issues contact support." --status=resolved

ops-runbook-bot: Resolved update published and incident marked resolved :tada:

alex chen: closing out. will file a short post-incident note with root cause: expired intermediate cert from vendor during rotation window + plan: add cert expiry monitor and automatic failover tests.

priya rao: thanks all — good coordinated response. I'll draft postmortem template and share in #postmortems for review. :heart:
